name: Kuga Tomoe
source:
A counselor hiding a secret behind his kindness.

While mainly working as an online counselor, he also helps out at the L&L café. He has a gentle demeanor but can be harsh specifically towards Yoshiya. Additionally, he doesn’t talk much about his private life.
